title: Kimi K3.1 Pro (Cerebras, Trial Run)
notes: Bring-up trial run on omp (92 commits, 7,404 tool calls). Re-graded on v3.1 (symmetric RDP bus model, section-weighted 40/50/10), its best valid checkpoint (4b54858, 15.7 h) scores 1.640x across all 25 routes (39.0% console frame time saved, 1.221x vs GCC -O2, PLAY=1 runtime smoke passing) — right behind the Kaze master reference (1.663x). Later commits extrapolated reduced-aliasing opaque modes to OPA_DECAL/OPA_INTER (cec7905) and added a 4-vertex shadow typo (253312a), reaching 1.82x on public courses while failing video fidelity on 7 of 19 private routes.
